subject: general
question: Let ΔABC ∼ Δ PQR and ar(∆ABC)/ar(∆PQR) =4/25. If AB = 12 cm, BC = 8 cm and AC = 9 cm, then QR is equal to:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/973ca71dbbc1d345dbc94342e9dea5b3213125b4c7a0bd670ebd64b5d54822f4.png] 

ΔABC ∼ ΔPQR

∴ (BC/QR)² = ar(∆ABC)/ar(∆PQR)

⇒ (8/QR)² = 4/25

⇒ 8/QR = 2/5

∴ QR = 20 cm
